verdict.rationale: Docs show CLI/API can create, delete, list databases and branches, run non-interactive SQL for agents, and there's an official hosted MCP server with service-token auth for headless/CI agents that provides database info and tools without touching the dashboard. Schema branching/deploy-request workflows are documented as programmatic (docs-9,11,41,17,19,44,45,49). Missing for 10: explicit documented command/API call for fetching a connection string end-to-end, and independent/hands-on confirmation that an agent can chain create→connect→schema→query fully via CLI/MCP without any dashboard step.
